notes.title: Patch Notes for 1.0.3.0
notes.content:
Hi all, this is a bit of a cumulative update - a few fixes and enhancements, but mostly to make some new items available!

- Added 'Box Blaster' custom gun item.
- Fixed box trail FX for the 'Biter' gun
- Added 'Boom Box' backpack item.
- Minor fix for 'Biter' trail FX.
- Added 'Beholder' custom head item (a  gross-looking eyeball!)
- Added 'Conehead' custom bot head item by @Moritz 
- Fixed the player respawn transition FX so that a bot's floating skull returns to the correct location even if spawn point is in motion.
- Added a match settings randomization option in Prematch > Setup, as suggested by @Chinnaru (experimental)
- Allow players to summon the Pause menu in Tutorial with keyboard (so that they can get back to the menu if controller runs outta juice)
- Some minor fixes to the P2P network backend
- Attempting to smooth out the motion of crates better when network conditions are poor
- Potential fix for multiple craterball goals being scoreable from a single craterball

notes.title: Patch Notes for 1.0.2.0
notes.content:
- Added Stuntbot custom head.
- Added Barrel custom backpack.
- Increased daily item drop limit from 4 to 5.
- Minor sound FX channel fixes (e.g. grinders in Crushers were not set as Gameplay SFX)
- Refactoring work on Steamworks integration
- Added visual indicator for items that are unlocked by default in the Inventory - thanks @da stealth 
- Added 'Default' Steam tag to items that are unlocked by default in the Inventory - thanks @da stealth 
- Allow players to exit Inventory during a refresh - thanks @Chinnaru 
- Used cached inventory data when a refresh times out
- Fixed rumble getting stuck on in Controls screen when rapidly pressing Identify on multiple controllers - thanks @da stealth
- Experimenting with adjusting network body syncrate to reduce upload demands on the host machine

notes.title: Patch Notes for 1.0.0.8
notes.content:
- Melee balancing adjustments: each hit does more damage, but attack rate is lower.
- Increase melee attack rate significantly when player has an active Speed Boost powerup.
- Potential fix for UI icons sometimes 'flip-flopping' when both KBM and controller are active - @Chinnaru 
- Disallow joining elimination games mid-match, and notify player that they are spectating.
- Potential fix for occasional failure to apply environmental damage to objects (e.g. Turbine fans) - @da stealth  & @Chinnaru 
- Added some alternate French toast vocals - thanks @marieAD!
- Fix for AI regarding craterball hoops as dangerous and avoiding them
- Groundwork for 'beta' levels that are only accessible from unstable branch
- Allow players to change level, preset, teams etc. directy from Match Setup screen - thanks @Chinnaru!
- Potential fix for loading screen not showing up when starting a match (thanks @da stealth!)
- Added new custom head: Unicron - @Moritz 
- Card selections should now be looping in the Prematch Match Setup screen - thanks @Buzzard and @Chinnaru 
- Converted Match Customization screen to be scrollable, in preparation for adding more customization options.
- Fixed Spinnaru and Unicron Gold heads not showing up in player portraits - thanks @Chinnaru 
- Fix for powerup buff FX not tracking the player properly when latency is high - thanks @Moritz
- Check item ownership in more places - thanks @Chinnaru 
- Fix for loading screen not looking correct if loading into a lobby directly from Discord - thanks @Chinnaru
